Actor.summary: You are exceptionally convincing when performing, mimicking voices, or maintaining a false identity.
Actor.how: Use Charisma (Deception or Performance). When copying a voice, first listen long enough to learn its rhythm; observers contest with Insight when doubt matters.
Actor.roll: Roll d20 + Charisma modifier + proficiency if trained against the listener’s Insight or a stated DC.

Alert.summary: You react quickly, notice danger early, and are difficult to surprise.
Alert.how: Apply the feat’s initiative and surprise benefits whenever conflict begins or an ambush is tested.
Alert.roll: Initiative is d20 + Dexterity modifier plus any feat bonus shown by your campaign rules.

Athlete.summary: Training improves climbing, jumping, recovery from prone, and physical transitions.
Athlete.how: Use it when movement would normally cost extra or when a jump or climb is uncertain.
Athlete.roll: Usually Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics), depending on approach.

Charger.summary: You turn a committed rush into a stronger strike or forceful shove.
Charger.how: Move decisively toward a target, then use the feat’s attack or shove rider when its movement requirement is met.
Charger.roll: Weapon attack: d20 + attack ability + proficiency. Shove: Athletics contested by Athletics or Acrobatics.

Crossbow Expert.summary: You handle crossbows in close quarters and fire them rapidly without normal loading problems.
Crossbow Expert.how: Apply the feat when using crossbows, especially near enemies or during repeated attacks.
Crossbow Expert.roll: d20 + Dexterity modifier + proficiency versus Armor Class.

Defensive Duelist.summary: A finesse weapon can be used to turn aside a dangerous melee hit.
Defensive Duelist.how: When a visible melee attack would hit, spend your Reaction and apply the feat’s defensive bonus.
Defensive Duelist.roll: No new roll; compare the revised Armor Class to the triggering attack total.

Dual Wielder.summary: You fight effectively with a weapon in each hand and can use broader weapon combinations.
Dual Wielder.how: Record both weapons. Use the normal two-weapon sequence and apply the feat’s defense/draw benefits.
Dual Wielder.roll: Each attack is d20 + relevant ability + proficiency; damage uses the weapon die and applicable modifier.

Dungeon Delver.summary: Practice with traps, hidden mechanisms, and collapsing ruins improves exploration survival.
Dungeon Delver.how: Use while searching, resisting, or reducing trap and environmental danger.
Dungeon Delver.roll: Usually Intelligence (Investigation), Wisdom (Perception), or a relevant saving throw.

Durable.summary: Your body recovers efficiently during rests and benefits more reliably from Hit Dice.
Durable.how: Apply whenever spending Hit Dice during a rest.
Durable.roll: Roll the Hit Die and add Constitution as normal, then apply the feat’s minimum/result rule.

Elemental Adept.summary: Choose one damage element; your spells penetrate resistance and produce steadier damage.
Elemental Adept.how: Mark the chosen element and apply only to spells dealing that type.
Elemental Adept.roll: Use the spell’s normal attack or save; modify damage dice as the feat directs.

Fey Touched.summary: Fey influence grants a mental ability increase and a small package of teleportation or enchantment/divination magic.
Fey Touched.how: Choose the granted spells and casting ability. Track free uses separately from spell-slot uses.
Fey Touched.roll: Spell attack or save uses the chosen casting ability and proficiency.

Grappler.summary: You specialize in securing, controlling, and exploiting grappled opponents.
Grappler.how: First grapple a target, then apply the feat’s follow-up control or attack benefits.
Grappler.roll: Strength (Athletics) contested by the target’s Athletics or Acrobatics.

Great Weapon Master.summary: Heavy-weapon training rewards committed strikes and momentum after critical hits or dropping foes.
Great Weapon Master.how: Use only with eligible heavy weapons; declare any accuracy-for-damage option before rolling.
Great Weapon Master.roll: d20 + Strength + proficiency versus AC; apply the declared modifier and weapon damage.

Healer.summary: A healer’s kit becomes a reliable field-treatment tool rather than simple stabilization gear.
Healer.how: Spend a kit use and the required action; record who has received the feat’s limited treatment.
Healer.roll: Usually no roll. Medicine may be called for only when the situation adds unusual risk.

Heavily Armored.summary: You gain heavy-armor training and a physical ability improvement.
Heavily Armored.how: Choose eligible ability improvement, then record heavy armor proficiency and recalculate AC/Guard when worn.
Heavily Armored.roll: No roll; armor may impose Strength or Stealth considerations.

Heavy Armor Master.summary: Heavy armor absorbs a portion of ordinary weapon harm and strengthens the wearer.
Heavy Armor Master.how: Apply only while wearing heavy armor and only to eligible physical damage.
Heavy Armor Master.roll: No roll; reduce damage after it is rolled, following the feat’s limit.

Infernal Constitution.summary: Fiendish resilience improves Constitution and resistance to specific environmental or elemental threats.
Infernal Constitution.how: Record the ability increase and each resistance/advantage benefit.
Infernal Constitution.roll: Use normal saving throws; advantage applies only to listed hazards.

Inspiring Leader.summary: A short, sincere address gives companions temporary resilience.
Inspiring Leader.how: Spend the required preparation time with creatures that can understand you, then record temporary HP.
Inspiring Leader.roll: Normally no roll; roleplay the address and calculate the benefit from level and Charisma.

Keen Mind.summary: Exceptional recall, orientation, and time sense make details difficult to lose.
Keen Mind.how: Ask the sheet’s rules/library for facts the character observed; this does not reveal information never perceived.
Keen Mind.roll: Usually no roll; Investigation may still be required to interpret remembered facts.

Lightly Armored.summary: You gain light-armor training and an ability improvement.
Lightly Armored.how: Record proficiency and recalculate AC/Guard when light armor is equipped.

Linguist.summary: You learn additional languages and can create or analyze coded writing.
Linguist.how: Add the languages to the sheet and describe the cipher key or decoding approach.
Linguist.roll: Intelligence (Investigation) or Linguistics Field when breaking an unfamiliar code.

Lucky.summary: A limited pool of luck can replace or challenge crucial d20 results.
Lucky.how: Track luck uses. Declare the use at the timing allowed by the feat and keep the chosen die.
Lucky.roll: Roll the additional d20 and apply the feat’s choice rule.

Mage Slayer.summary: You pressure nearby spellcasters, disrupt concentration, and resist magic used at close range.
Mage Slayer.how: Watch for casting within reach and use the feat’s Reaction or concentration rider.
Mage Slayer.roll: Weapon attack versus AC; the caster may make a concentration save after damage.

Magic Initiate.summary: Study or inherited talent grants cantrips and one low-rank spell from a chosen tradition.
Magic Initiate.how: Choose tradition, casting ability, spells, and free-use reset. Add them to the spell builder.
Magic Initiate.roll: Use the chosen casting ability for spell attacks and save DC.

Martial Adept.summary: You learn a small number of combat maneuvers and gain a maneuver die.
Martial Adept.how: Choose maneuvers, track the die, and spend it only at the trigger stated by the maneuver.
Martial Adept.roll: Attack or save DC follows the maneuver and your selected physical ability.

Medium Armor Master.summary: You move quietly and defend more effectively in medium armor when Dexterity supports it.
Medium Armor Master.how: Apply only while wearing medium armor; update stealth and AC calculations.
Medium Armor Master.roll: No extra roll; Stealth uses the normal Dexterity check without the removed penalty.

Mobile.summary: Speed and footwork let you cross battlefields and disengage from creatures you attack.
Mobile.how: Apply the speed increase and mark enemies you attacked this turn for the movement benefit.
Mobile.roll: Attacks use normal rolls; difficult terrain or stunts may call for Athletics/Acrobatics.

Moderately Armored.summary: You gain medium armor and shield training plus an ability increase.
Moderately Armored.how: Record proficiency and recalculate AC/Guard when equipment changes.

Mounted Combatant.summary: You protect and exploit a trained mount during battle.
Mounted Combatant.how: Remain mounted, track mount HP/defenses, redirect eligible attacks, and apply advantage where allowed.
Mounted Combatant.roll: Weapon attacks normally; Animal Handling for dangerous control or calming.

Observant.summary: Careful attention improves passive awareness and lip-reading or detail recognition.
Observant.how: Update passive Perception/Investigation and note languages required for lip-reading.
Observant.roll: Passive score handles unnoticed details; active checks use Perception or Investigation.

Piercer.summary: Piercing-weapon expertise improves an ability, allows limited damage rerolls, and strengthens critical hits.
Piercer.how: Mark one damage reroll per turn and apply the extra critical die only to piercing damage.
Piercer.roll: Normal weapon attack; reroll one eligible damage die and keep the new result.

Polearm Master.summary: Polearms threaten space effectively and can make a quick follow-up strike.
Polearm Master.how: Use only with listed polearms; track the bonus strike and entry-triggered Reaction.
Polearm Master.roll: Normal melee attack rolls using Strength unless the weapon says otherwise.

Resilient.summary: Choose an ability; improve it and gain proficiency in that ability’s saving throws.
Resilient.how: Update the score and check the matching save proficiency box.
Resilient.roll: d20 + ability modifier + proficiency bonus for that saving throw.

Ritual Caster.summary: You maintain a ritual book and can perform learned ritual spells without routine slot use.
Ritual Caster.how: Choose the tradition, record rituals, required time, and material components.
Ritual Caster.roll: Usually no spell roll unless the ritual becomes a Challenge; then use the relevant casting ability or Field.

Savage Attacker.summary: Once during a turn, you can reroll melee weapon damage and keep the preferred total.
Savage Attacker.how: Declare after seeing eligible damage, reroll the weapon dice, and choose one result.
Savage Attacker.roll: No extra attack roll; reroll damage only.

Sentinel.summary: You hold enemies in place, punish attacks on allies, and make opportunity attacks especially controlling.
Sentinel.how: Reserve your Reaction and apply the feat when an enemy moves or attacks another creature.
Sentinel.roll: Melee weapon attack versus AC; on a hit apply the feat’s movement consequence.

Shadow Touched.summary: Shadow influence grants a mental ability increase, invisibility magic, and one additional subtle spell.
Shadow Touched.how: Choose spells and casting ability; track free uses and slot-based uses.
Shadow Touched.roll: Use chosen casting ability for attacks or save DC.

Sharpshooter.summary: Long-range weapon mastery ignores common distance and cover limitations and permits committed high-damage shots.
Sharpshooter.how: Use with eligible ranged weapons; declare any accuracy trade before the attack.
Sharpshooter.roll: d20 + Dexterity + proficiency versus AC, modified by the declared option.

Shield Master.summary: A shield supports forceful shoves, Dexterity defense, and protection from area effects.
Shield Master.how: You must be wielding a shield; use the shove timing and saving-throw benefits as listed.
Shield Master.roll: Shove uses Athletics contested by Athletics or Acrobatics; saves use the normal Dexterity save.

Skilled.summary: You gain proficiency in three chosen skills, tools, or Fields.
Skilled.how: Choose three distinct proficiencies and mark them on the sheet.
Skilled.roll: Future tests add proficiency when the chosen training applies.

Skulker.summary: You hide and attack more effectively in poor visibility without immediately revealing yourself on every miss.
Skulker.how: Apply in dim light, concealment, and ranged hidden attacks where the feat qualifies.
Skulker.roll: Dexterity (Stealth) versus passive or active Perception; attacks are normal.

Spell Sniper.summary: Your ranged spells reach farther, ignore common cover, and include an additional attack cantrip.
Spell Sniper.how: Choose the cantrip and casting ability, then apply range and cover benefits to spell attacks.
Spell Sniper.roll: d20 + spellcasting ability + proficiency versus AC.

Tavern Brawler.summary: Improvised weapons, unarmed attacks, and close grappling become practical combat tools.
Tavern Brawler.how: After an eligible hit, use the feat’s grapple option and treat suitable objects as weapons.
Tavern Brawler.roll: Attack uses Strength + proficiency when trained; grapple uses Athletics contest.

Telekinetic.summary: Mental force improves a mental ability, manipulates objects, and can push creatures.
Telekinetic.how: Record the invisible hand effect and use the bonus-action shove at its stated range.
Telekinetic.roll: Target makes a Strength save against 8 + PB + chosen mental ability modifier.

Telepathic.summary: Mental communication and limited thought-reading improve a mental ability.
Telepathic.how: Record range, language limits, and the granted spell/use reset. Telepathy does not automatically compel truth.
Telepathic.roll: Any granted save uses 8 + PB + chosen mental ability modifier.

Tough.summary: Your maximum hit points increase at every character level.
Tough.how: Recalculate maximum HP whenever total level changes.

War Caster.summary: Combat casting improves concentration, somatic casting with occupied hands, and reactive spell use.
War Caster.how: Apply advantage to concentration saves and use the spell Reaction only when its targeting rules qualify.
War Caster.roll: Concentration is a Constitution save; reactive spell uses its normal attack or save.

Weapon Master.summary: You gain training with selected weapons and an ability increase.
Weapon Master.how: Choose weapons, record proficiency, and update attacks to include PB.
Weapon Master.roll: d20 + relevant ability + proficiency versus AC.
